title: predicate-category
description: The small category C in which predicates live: the typed index, made to compose, that licenses reindexing one predication cell's value onto related cells. Generated by predicating, it is distinct from the discrete predication-cell set.

objects.description: the predicates that inhabit this category as its objects

morphismClasses.description: the four canonical seed classes the whole category is generated from, each acting on cells through the predicate coordinate

reindexes.description: the predication cells whose values the morphisms reindex

composition.description: morphisms compose associatively: (h . g) . f = h . (g . f)

identities.description: every predicate has an identity morphism that is a unit for composition
